args.summary: Deployment v2.3.1 of checkout-api caused health check failures and an elevated error rate (18%) in production. A rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) was initiated in all regions. The first rollback attempt failed partway (us-east rolled back; us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1 due to an orchestrator error), so the rollback was retried and completed successfully. All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now running v2.3.0, health checks pass, and error rate is back to 0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is identified.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures following v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

The incident was successfully created despite the timeout (INC-0001, status: open). All tasks are complete.

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate spiked to 18%).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Identified rollback target:** Release history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was the unhealthy deploy).
2. **Rolled back:** First rollback attempt hit an orchestrator error after us-east only; verified mixed-version state, then retried and successfully rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified health:** Service is now healthy across all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident:** SEV2 incident **INC-0001** filed for checkout-api, documenting the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is identified.
